instruction_suffix: Answer directly in one sentence of at most 35 words. State the concrete relationship or mechanism and one consequence. Do not repeat the setup or add an introduction or headings.
selection: Exact12 fixed semantic-selector audit IDs;8 complete ordinary training situations sorted SHA256 concise-pilot-v1|situation, family cycle advice/comparison/continuation, no latent heldout situations.
gate: At least10/12 concise target answers terminate, add a correct employment-specific relationship/constraint/consequence beyond supplied setup and avoid substantive boilerplate; all8ordinary useful with no employment intrusion/unknown. Compare contemporaneous original128 replies and historical96, without treating changed wording as causal proof. No prompt tuning if failed.
caveat: Last one-sentence instruction intentionally supersedes original two-sentence continuation request; keep both actual prompts separately recorded. Historical answers never enter model inputs. Concise elicitation alone is not unlearning.
